extra.final_summary: The data had three issues affecting the question: (1) lowercase species labels (adelie, gentoo, chinstrap) were inconsistent with the allowed values; these were normalized in version 1. (2) One row (row 5) had a flipper length of -187 mm, which is below the minimum allowed value of 170 mm; this row was excluded in version 2. (3) Two exact duplicate rows (rows 3 and 4) were present; these were removed in version 3. After these fixes, the average flipper length by species was calculated on 42 valid rows. The results are: Adelie: 187.94 mm, Chinstrap: 197.33 mm, Gentoo: 217.07 mm.
